items.title_en: How Brits would really spend a lottery jackpot - and it’s not what you’d expect
items.title_zh: 英国人真正会如何花掉彩票头奖——这不是你想象的那样
items.summary_en: A new survey reveals who Brits would happily share their lottery winnings with - and who they wouldn't. One in 10 Brits admit they'd buy the house next door so they could choose their neighbours if they won the lottery. A poll of 2,000 adults found 52% would do something frivolous if they won a major jackpot prize. Other such acts included paying someone to do all their queuing for them for the rest of their life and hiring a lookalike to attend dull events so they don’t have to.

items.title_en: 9 Chilling Native American Ghost Stories, From Cannibals To Evil Otters
items.title_zh: 9 个令人毛骨悚然的美国原住民鬼故事，从食人者到邪恶的水獭
items.summary_en: Told beneath a sky full of stars, or in the warmth of a longhouse, Native American ghost stories have been passed down from generation to generation. Though time has passed, they remain as terrifying as ever. Some stories feature ghosts so fearsome that no one will speak their real name — like the so-called skinwalkers or Stick People. Others weave together tales of cannibalism, drowned spirits, and violent ghouls.
items.summary_zh: 在满天繁星的天空下或在温暖的长屋里讲述的美国原住民鬼故事代代相传。尽管时间过去了，但它们仍然像以前一样令人恐惧。有些故事中的鬼魂非常可怕，以至于没有人会说出他们的真名——比如所谓的“皮行者”或“棍人”。其他人则将食人、淹死的灵魂和暴力食尸鬼的故事编织在一起。
